cards.title: Why birth rates are plummeting and what it means
cards.body: Author Camilla Cavendish explores why people are having fewer children, citing dating apps, unaffordable housing, and climate concerns. Understanding these trends is crucial for families considering parenthood.

cards.title: Raising a child with ultra-rare genetic disorder
cards.body: A parent shares her journey raising a daughter with a one-in-163-million genetic condition. The deeply personal account reveals the love, hope, and challenges of navigating complex medical needs.

cards.title: Teaching life skills middle-class kids are missing
cards.body: Parents often overlook essential domestic skills like laundry and cooking, leaving kids unprepared for independence. Young adults benefit from learning these practical abilities before leaving home.

cards.title: Parenting through unexpected challenges on the road
cards.body: A parent describes managing a child's illness during a stressful situation and receiving unexpected kindness from strangers. These moments reveal the importance of community support during parenting crises.

cards.title: Finding community and purpose in suburban parenting
cards.body: A family discovered unexpected joy in suburban life after initially feeling disappointed with the move. The experience teaches parents to look beyond first impressions when building family routines.

cards.title: Assessing what domestic wisdom you've taught your children
cards.body: A parent realized at an Ikea trip that she hadn't imparted much practical household knowledge to her pre-university son. The experience highlights the importance of teaching domestic skills before kids leave home.

cards.title: Self-aware parenting in youth sports
cards.body: Youth sports can bring stress and opportunity to families, but parents must distinguish their own expectations from their child's desires. Helping kids see themselves beyond their athletic performance is essential for healthy development.

cards.title: Middle childhood transitions for parents too
cards.body: As children enter middle childhood and gain independence, parents experience their own developmental changes. Understanding this mutual transition helps families navigate growing autonomy together.

cards.title: Location tracking apps and parental anxiety
cards.body: Parents increasingly use tracking technology to monitor loved ones' movements, creating what some call 'compassionate surveillance.' While intended to ensure safety, it raises questions about whether constant monitoring helps or hinders family relationships.

cards.title: Postpartum psychosis and the mental health system
cards.body: When mothers struggle with postpartum psychosis and the mental health system fails them, outcomes can be tragic. Better support and recognition of this serious condition is critical for protecting mothers and families.
